customer.codeHint: Iprintwe kwiphosta yevenkile, phantsi kwekhowudi ye-QR.

unreachable.title: Asikwazi ukufikelela i-AnyPay ngoku
unreachable.description: Intlawulo yakho ikhuselekile kwiwalethi yakho. Siyaqhubeka sizama, kwaye eli phepha liza kuzihlaziya.

empty.title: Akukabikho ntlawulo
empty.description: Iintlawulo zivela apha kwangoko xa zifika, kwaye ifowuni yakho ingazifunda ngokuvakalayo.

setUp.title: Akukabikho venkile kule fowuni
setUp.description: Ukulungiselela kuthatha ngaphantsi kwemizuzu emibini: idilesi yewalethi yakho negama levenkile.

unauthorized.title: Le fowuni iphumile kwivenkile
unauthorized.description: Vula ikhonkco levenkile yakho kwakhona, okanye ulungiselele ivenkile kwakhona.

failures.consent_declined: Intlawulo yaliwe kwiwalethi. Akukho mali ithathiweyo.
failures.consent_invalid: Imvume ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa, ngoko akukho mali ithathiweyo.
failures.consent_timeout: Intlawulo ayivunywanga ngexesha. Akukho mali ithathiweyo.
failures.quote_expired: Ixabiso liphelelwe lixesha phambi kokuba intlawulo ivunywe. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
failures.timeout: Imali ithatha ixesha elide ukufika. Khangela iwalethi phambi kokuhlawula kwakhona.

tab.title: Iithebhu zam

empty.title: Akukho thebhu zivuliweyo
empty.description: Vula ithebhu kwispaza sakho kanye, uze uhlawule ngokuchukumisa, nokuba akukho nethiwekhi.

tab.howToOpen: Skena ikhowudi ye-QR yevenkile, uze ukhethe Vula ithebhu kule venkile.

open.title: Vula ithebhu
open.intro: Hlawula i-{{shop}} ngokuchukumisa, nokuba akukho fowuni inenethiwekhi. Uvuma umda weveki kanye, kwiwalethi yakho.
open.labelHint: Ivenkile ibona eli gama ecaleni kwethebhu yakho.
open.capHint: Esona sixa sikhulu le thebhu enokusithatha ngeveki. Iwalethi yakho iyibamba kuloo mda.
open.offline: Ukuvula ithebhu kufuna inethiwekhi kanye. Emva koko isebenza ngaphandle kwayo.

detail.waiting: Vuma umda weveki kwiwalethi yakho ukuze uqalise ukusebenzisa le thebhu.
detail.failed: Le thebhu ayivulwanga. Akukho mali ithathiweyo.
detail.callbackError: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa imvume yakho. Khangela iwalethi yakho, uze uzame ukuvula ithebhu kwakhona.
detail.otherPhone: Le thebhu ivulwe kwenye ifowuni, ngoko yiloo fowuni kuphela enokuhlawula ngayo.
detail.howToPay: Ukuhlawula, cela ivenkile intengiso yethebhu uze uskene ikhowudi ye-QR abakubonisa yona.

settings.title: Iisetingi
settings.simulateOfflineHint: Ibonisa ukusebenza kwethebhu ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngaphandle kokuvala ifowuni. Akukho nto ifika kwiseva de uyicime.

privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
privacy.intro: I-AnyPay idlulisa iintlawulo phakathi kweewalethi. Igcina okuncinci kangangoko inako, kwaye ayiyiboni iphasiwedi okanye ibhalansi yewalethi yakho.

shop.heading: Xa usungula ivenkile
shop.details: Igama levenkile yakho, idilesi yewalethi kunye nohlobo lwemali.
shop.key: Isitshixo sokungena sevenkile yakho sihlala kwifowuni yakho. Sigcina kuphela uphawu lwaso, olungenakuguqulwa lube sisitshixo kwakhona.

payment.heading: Xa umntu ehlawula
payment.amounts: Isixa, oko umthengi akuhlawulileyo kubandakanya iifizi, imeko kunye nexesha.
payment.encrypted: Idilesi yewalethi yomthengi kunye nemvume ayivumileyo, zigcinwe zifihliwe (AES-256-GCM).
payment.shopSees: Ivenkile ibona izixa namaxesha, ayiyiboni idilesi yewalethi yakho.
payment.tab: Kwithebhu: igama oyinika lona (ivenkile iyalibona), umda wayo weveki kunye nesitshixo sikawonke-wonke sefowuni yakho, esijonga iintengiso ezingaphandle kwe-intanethi.

phone.heading: Kwifowuni yakho kuphela
phone.settings: Ulwimi lwakho, imbonakalo neesetingi zelizwi, kunye nedilesi yewalethi ohlawule ngayo okokugqibela.
phone.offline: Iivenkile ozihlawulileyo kunye neentengiso zanamhlanje, ukuze zivuleke nokuba akukho nethiwekhi.
phone.tab: Isitshixo sethebhu yakho, esingenakukhutshelwa ngaphandle kwefowuni, kunye neentengiso ezingaphandle kwe-intanethi ezilindele ukuthunyelwa.

never.heading: Esingaze sikuqokelele
never.items: Inombolo yesazisi sakho, inombolo yefowuni, indawo okanye abafowunelwa. Akukho zintengiso, akukho zilandeli, akukho kuki zohlalutyo.

others.heading: Abanye ababandakanyekayo
others.wallet: Umboneleli wewalethi yakho ucela imvume yakho aze ahambise imali. Imigaqo yakhe yobumfihlo iyasebenza.
others.hosting: Iiseva zethu kunye nogcino-lwazi zise-Yurophu (Render kunye ne-Neon).
others.logs: Iirekhodi zethu zibhala izicelo neempazamo kuphela: akukho dilesi zewalethi, zitshixo okanye iidilesi ze-IP.

keep.heading: Siyigcina ixesha elingakanani
keep.demo: Lo ngumboniso onemali yovavanyo kuphela. Iintlawulo zigcinwa de umboniso uqalwe kwakhona. Iirekhodi ezenza ukuzama kwakhona kukhuseleke zicinywa emva kosuku.

rights.heading: Amalungelo akho (POPIA)
rights.body: Ungabuza ukuba yintoni esinayo ngawe, kwaye ucele ukuba siyilungise okanye siyicime.

add.heading: Yongeza ifowuni
add.description: Skena le khowudi ngekhamera yenye ifowuni. Ivula i-{{shop}} apho, neentlawulo ezifika ngoko nangoko.
add.warning: Nabani na oyiskenayo angazibona iintengiso zakho. Yibonise kuphela abantu obathembayo.

signOut.heading: Ulahlekelwe yifowuni?
signOut.description: Khupha zonke ezinye iifowuni. Le fowuni ihlala ingene; ezinye zifuna ikhowudi entsha yokungena.
signOut.confirmDescription: Ziyayeka ukubona iintengiso zakho kwangoko, kwaye iikhowudi zokungena ezabonisiwe ngaphambili ziyayeka ukusebenza.
signOut.done: Ezinye iifowuni zikhutshiwe. Yile fowuni kuphela eqhuba ivenkile ngoku.

offline.banner: Awukho kwi-intanethi. I-AnyPay iyaqhubeka isebenza kwaye iza kuvumelanisa xa ubuyile.
